title: Tickets
tagline: The end of ticket fraud; event access, reimagined; simple, secure, seamless with World ID.
description:
Tickets on World enable verified users to create events, buy and sell tickets, resell tickets, prove the ownership of a ticket. The vision is to prevent bots from scooping up tickets from honest supporters and attendees. Only verified humans can transact, therefore, no algorithm will maximise ticket resale profitability; that is an issue in current web2 solutions. 

The World app is a perfect place to host such an app as it offers World ID. Thanks to World ID, vendors can protect their event from bad actors. On the other hand, user benefit from a seamless marketplace and the confidence of their ticket being unique.
how_its_made:
Front-end is made on Vercel with the help of v0. The remainder was done in Cursor, also with the help of LLMs, specifically Claude 4.0. 

We used Supabase with PostgreSQL database for event storage. And we used World Chain Sepolia Testnet.

I personally, Tomas, learned how fragile is writing code solely through vibez as it is crucial to understand it as a whole.
